wellopti.options.title: WellOpti Settings
wellopti.options.disableWhileScoping.too: Draw everything at full distance while you're looking through a spyglass.
wellopti.options.dynamicFps.enabled.tool: Lower the frame rate when you aren't looking at the game, so your GPU, fans and battery get a break.
wellopti.options.dynamicFps.unfocused.to: FPS cap while another window has focus, for example when you alt-tab.
wellopti.options.dynamicFps.minimized.to: FPS cap while the game window is minimised. Vanilla uses 10.
wellopti.options.dynamicFps.paused.toolt: FPS cap while a singleplayer game is paused.
wellopti.options.entityCulling.enabled.t: Skip drawing small or decorative entities that are far away. Glowing entities are always drawn.
wellopti.options.entityCulling.droppedIt: Distance past which dropped items aren't drawn.
wellopti.options.entityCulling.experienc: Distance past which experience orbs aren't drawn.
wellopti.options.entityCulling.itemFrame: Distance past which item frames, and the maps and items in them, aren't drawn.
wellopti.options.entityCulling.armorStan: Distance past which armor stands aren't drawn.
wellopti.options.entityCulling.stuckArro: Distance past which arrows and tridents stuck in blocks aren't drawn. Arrows in flight are always drawn.
wellopti.options.entityCulling.ambientMo: Distance past which bats, fish, tadpoles and squid aren't drawn.
wellopti.options.blockEntityCulling.enab: Skip drawing detailed blocks that are far away. Vanilla draws these out to 64 blocks.
wellopti.options.blockEntityCulling.sign: Distance past which text on signs isn't drawn. The sign itself stays visible.
wellopti.options.blockEntityCulling.bann: Distance past which banners aren't drawn.
wellopti.options.blockEntityCulling.skul: Distance past which mob and player heads aren't drawn.
wellopti.options.blockEntityCulling.stor: Distance past which chests, ender chests and shulker boxes aren't drawn.
wellopti.options.blockEntityCulling.item: Distance past which items on shelves and campfires, and decorated pots, aren't drawn.
wellopti.options.particles.enabled.toolt: Limit how many particles can exist at once, so explosions and particle spam can't tank your FPS.
wellopti.options.particles.max.tooltip: The most particles allowed at once. Item pickup animations always get through.
